$comment: Upstream container images this repository pulls, and where CI gets them instead.
WHY A MIRROR. Anonymous Docker Hub pulls are limited to 100 per six hours per
IPv4 address. This repository pulls six images per CI run and will never
exhaust that alone — the quota is spent by OTHER tenants sharing GitHub's
hosted-runner addresses. So the fix is not to pull less, it is to stop
depending on Docker Hub at CI time. GitHub Container Registry has no pull
WHY THE ORIGINAL NAMES ARE UNCHANGED. scripts/prime-images.ts pulls each
`mirror` and retags it to its `source` name before any suite starts, so every
Dockerfile, manifest and fixture keeps the reference it already had. CI and a
laptop run the same strings; nothing has to know the mirror exists.
ABOUT `id`. This is the image CONFIG digest (`docker inspect --format {{.Id}}`),
not the registry manifest digest. The manifest digest changes when an image is
copied between registries, so it cannot verify anything after the retag; the
config digest does not. It IS platform-specific, so these values are the
linux/amd64 ones the mirror workflow records, and prime-images only checks them
when running on that platform. An empty string means the mirror has not run
since this image was added — priming still works, it just cannot verify.
